question: Will the U.S. unemployment rate (BLS, seasonally adjusted) for October 2026 (the latest monthly reading dated on or before 2026-10-13) be above 4.2%, its value for June 2026?

rule.threshold_basis: the latest reading as of 2026-07-15 (June 2026), rounded as shown

source: Source: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics
